target.game: Need for Speed: Most Wanted - Black Edition (NTSC-U)

patches.name: Remove 2005 Brown/Yellow Visual Treatment
patches.description: Disables the heavy sepia/brown-yellow post-processing filter for clean, modern natural colors.
patches.author: fobes (verified on SLUS_213.51)

writes.note: Disable brownish-yellow visual treatment post-processing flag

patches.name: Remove Smeared PS2 Motion Blur
patches.description: Disables the low-res PS2 accumulation motion blur that smears and ghosts at 4K internal resolution.
patches.author: PeterDelta (verified on SLUS_213.51)

writes.note: MIPS: addiu v0, zero, 1 -> addiu v0, zero, 0
MIPS: bne v1, v0, +4 -> beq v1, v0, +4

patches.name: Widescreen 16:9 Projection Ratio (Static ELF Portion)
patches.description: Updates the static projection aspect ratio constant from 0.71f (4:3) to 0.75f (16:9). Pair with the runtime widescreen flag (0x00AAFDD4=1) via .pnach or in-game widescreen toggle.
patches.author: PeterDelta (verified on SLUS_213.51)

patches.name: Remove Atmospheric Brume / Distance Haze
patches.description: Clears thick 2005 distance haze/brume for sharper horizon visibility at 4K. Optional: can make distant LOD pop-in more visible until Phase 3 draw-distance patches land.
patches.author: PeterDelta (verified on SLUS_213.51)
